calls.title: GrowthBook <> Yorkshire Wildlife Park - Intro
calls.summary: The Yorkshire Wildlife Park team discussed their shift from opinion-based decisions to data-driven experimentation to navigate economic challenges post-Covid and Brexit. Alex Proven emphasized the need for improved data integrity and testing, as growth has plateaued and experimentation becomes essential. Mickey North highlighted the limitations of their current data architecture, which lacks integration and hampers insight generation. The team introduced GrowthBook as a flexible platform for rapid, measurable tests, with features like a visual editor and guardrails for critical performance metrics. The integration of finance and commercial insights was stressed, emphasizing the importance of accurate data for smarter decision-making in this new strategy. Next steps include initial testing and vendor comparisons before making a formal decision.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, Yorkshire Wildlife Park, experimentation, visual editor, data integration, A/B testing
